verdict.rationale: The official README shows `llama cli -hf ggml-org/Qwen3.5-0.8B-GGUF` and `llama serve -hf ...-GGUF` loading and running GGUF-packaged models directly, alongside its family of integer quantizations. Community users report running quantized models such as Q6_K and quantized multimodal Gemma-3 models. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation describing the GGUF format and loading local GGUF files (e.g. by path), and independent reports that name GGUF loading directly rather than only the quant types.
